newsitem.title: CANADA: Lionheart to consider merger, acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Lionheart to consider merger, acquisition.

text.p: Lionheart Energy Corp said on Wednesday it retained a new financial adviser to consider strategic alternatives, including proposals for the acquisition, merger or recapitalization of Lionheart.
Lionheart said its board concluded that a business combination with another company would best enhance the company's value to its shareholders in the near term.

It said the previously announced private placement of up to C$1.6 million of Lionheart common shares to a strategic investor would not occur at this time because of its decision to pursue strategic alternatives.
It said it retained Peters & Co Ltd as its financial adviser and expected to open a data room for qualified parties by early November.
